ingredients: Coconut - 1/4 cup, chopped into small pieces
method: Soak the raw rice, parboiled rice, toor dal, chana dal, 1/2 cup urad dal, and 1/2 cup moong dal together for 3-4 hours.
Separately soak the 1/4 cup of urad dal and 1/4 cup of moong dal to be added whole later.
Grind the main soaked rice and dals coarsely with red chilies, a pinch of asafoetida, and salt. The batter should be neither too tight nor too runny.
Add the separately soaked whole urad dal, moong dal, and chopped coconut pieces to the batter.
Heat a little oil in a small pan, temper with mustard seeds, 1 tsp urad dal, and curry leaves, then pour this into the batter and mix well.
Heat oil for deep frying. Using a small ladle, pour the batter into the hot oil.
Cook on a medium flame until golden brown, flipping once to cook both sides evenly.
Drain on paper towels and serve.
notes: Note: This refined version uses 5 red chilies and additional whole dals for texture. The original handwritten recipe suggests up to 12 red chilies for a spicier version.
